sections.summary: M3+ emphasises intentional collaboration between M3 agencies and MMOs, IMOs and informal groups in several areas.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In fact, with M3+, it signifies a greater emphasis on more intentional collaborations between the M3 agencies and the MMOs, IMOs and informal groups.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Among the areas, we look at how to strengthen marriages, youth development, healthcare and supporting workers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will see how in some of these areas, where the MMOs, IMOs and as well as informal groups can play a part.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have the Malay/Muslim Organisations Rehabilitation Network, where we see many of the MMOs and IMOs coming together to support.

sections.label: Sufficient prayer spaces for Muslims
sections.summary: Ensuring sufficient prayer spaces for all Muslims is a priority, and a population-to-mosque ratio is insufficient.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Our priority is ensuring that there are sufficient prayer spaces for all Muslims in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, simply using a ratio of Muslim population to mosques is insufficient as worship patterns, resident concentrations and mosque sizes vary across Singapore.

sections.label: New mosques in Tampines and Tengah
sections.summary: New mosques will be explored if population patterns change or a new housing estate comes up, as in Tampines and Tengah.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my speech, if there are changes to the population patterns or a new housing estate coming up, we will explore building new mosques like what we are doing in Tampines and Tengah.

sections.label: SpexSG company limited by guarantee
sections.summary: From 1 April, the company limited by guarantee called SpexSG will be in effect.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: From 1 April, the company limited by guarantee called SpexSG will be in effect.

sections.label: Consolidation benefits take time
sections.summary: It will take a year or two before the benefits of the consolidation are fully reaped.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: It is things that have already been going on.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: But we do expect to take the better of the next year or two before we can fully reap a lot of the benefits of the consolidation that I talked about earlier.

sections.label: SG Partnerships Fund Sprout tier questions
sections.summary: The member asks about the Sprout tier's 20% co-funding, tax deduction, funding sources, flexibility and MCCY support.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Kenneth Goh
sentences.text: My final question has to do with the SG Partnerships Fund.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Kenneth Goh
sentences.text: It was mentioned that for the Sprout tier, there is a 20% co-funding requirement.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Kenneth Goh
sentences.text: I was wondering if the Minister could elaborate on whether donations would qualify for the 250% tax deduction or whether this could be funded through earned revenue, whether there is flexibility in how this contribution could be structured and whether MCCY could provide support to help organisations or to help these initiatives secure these funds, particularly in the area of fundraising and partnership development.

sections.label: Services after carding ceases
sections.summary: Athletes needing athlete life or other services after they cease being carded is not a problem.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: In instances where they require athlete life services or other services after they cease being carded, it is not a problem.

sections.label: Sprout and Scale tier funding details
sections.summary: Sprout tier is $50,000 over two years and Scale tier $1 million over three years, with co-funding not upfront and donations or earned revenue allowable.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For the Sprout tier, it is $50,000 over two years, and for the Scale tier, it is $1 million over three years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Allow me to assure him that the 20% to be co-funded does not have to be done upfront.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And the source of funding that he mentioned, whether is it donation or earned revenue, they are allowable.

sections.label: OBS priority MOE-OBS Challenge
sections.summary: The priority for OBS is the MOE-OBS Challenge scale-up for Secondary 3 students up to 2030.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my main speech, our priority for OBS is the MOE-OBS Challenge scale-up for Secondary 3 students up to 2030.

sections.label: Enough resources to support them
sections.summary: The assessment is that there should be enough resources to support them.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: My assessment is that we should have enough resources to support them.

sections.label: Outdoor machines adjustable weights trial
sections.summary: A trial in Woodlands is looking at adjustable weights for outdoor machines, and rollout will follow when data and confidence are sufficient.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: For example, there is a trial in Woodlands, if I am not wrong, where we are also looking at adjustable weights for outdoor machines.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: These are all things we are looking at and when we have sufficient data and confidence that some of these things work well in an outdoor setting, we will proceed to roll them out.

sections.label: Programmes after dark study
sections.summary: They are keen to study and pilot possible programmes after dark, in museums or otherwise, with NYC playing a big role.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: Well, we will certainly be very keen to study as well as pilot possible programmes after dark, whether it is in our museums or otherwise, and certainly NYC will have a big role to play in this.

sections.label: Place-making Project Office coverage
sections.summary: The new Place-making Project Office under the Inter-agency Task Force serves Kampong Gelam, Little India and also Chinatown.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As far as his historic district is concerned, I want to assure him that the new Place-making Project Office that comes under the Inter-agency Task Force does indeed not only serve Kampong Gelam, Little India, but also Chinatown.

sections.label: MOE-OBS Challenge sites
sections.summary: Sites for the MOE-OBS Challenge will primarily be OBS' sites, namely Pulau Ubin and the upcoming Coney Island campus.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: To the Member's questions on sites for the MOE-OBS Challenge, yes, it will primarily be OBS' sites, so, they will be Pulau Ubin and also the Coney Island campus that will be coming up.
